Usage:
  alucard run [TARGET_REPO] [options]
  alucard queue [TARGET_REPO] [options]
  alucard build [options]
  alucard doctor [TARGET_REPO] [options]
  alucard continue <PR_NUM> [TARGET_REPO] [options]
  alucard merge <PR_NUM> [TARGET_REPO] [options]
  alucard version

TARGET_REPO accepts:
  /path/to/local/repo          existing local git clone
  owner/repo                   GitHub shorthand — auto-cloned on first run
  https://github.com/owner/repo  full GitHub HTTPS URL

Commands:
  run       Run the autonomous worker loop.
  queue     Print the currently eligible task queue as JSON — GitHub issues,
            or a local tasks file when one is configured or auto-detected.
  build     Build the Alucard Docker image.
  doctor    Check local prerequisites without running the worker.
  continue  Re-run the feedback+CI+review pipeline on a parked PR.
  merge     Rebase a harness-approved PR onto its base, run the full check
            command on this machine, post the result, and squash-merge.
  version   Print the CLI version and exit.

Run options:
  -C, --repo PATH              Target git repository. Defaults to
                               ALUCARD_TARGET_REPO or the current directory.
  -n, --iterations N           Max iterations to run. Default: 20.
  -t, --timeout-minutes N      Per-iteration timeout. Default: 30.
      --base BRANCH            Base branch on origin. Default: main.
      --env-file PATH          Credential env file. Default: ./alucard.env
                               beside this CLI.
      --image NAME             Docker image name. Default: ghcr.io/aldovc/alucard:latest.
      --logs-root PATH         Directory for run logs. Default:
                               ~/.local/state/alucard/logs (XDG_STATE_HOME
                               honoured). A path under /tmp prints a warning.
      --max-review-cycles N    Max reviewer→feedback loops per PR. Default: 10.
      --no-build               Do not build the image if it is missing or
                               stale. Warns instead of rebuilding.
      --tasks PATH             Read tasks from a local tasks file instead of
                               the GitHub issue queue. Defaults to
                               ALUCARD_TASKS_FILE, else auto-detects
                               .alucard/tasks.md in the target repo.
      --github                 Force the GitHub issue queue even when a local
                               tasks file exists.
      --issue N                Run exactly one iteration on open GitHub
                               issue N. Forces the GitHub task source.
                               Cannot be combined with --tasks.

Continue options:
  <PR_NUM>                     Open PR number to continue (required, positional).
  Same flags as run apply: -C, -t, --env-file, --image, --logs-root,
  --max-review-cycles, --no-build.

Merge options:
  <PR_NUM>                     Open PR to merge (required, positional). Refused
                               unless the harness reviewer approved its
                               current head.
      --check-command CMD      Full check command, run with bash in a fresh
                               clone of the rebased branch on this machine,
                               not in a container. Defaults to
                               ALUCARD_CHECK_COMMAND (environment or env
                               file). Never read from the PR. -t bounds it.
      --dry-run                Rebase and run the checks, but push, comment,
                               label and merge nothing.
  Also accepts -C, -t, --env-file, --logs-root.

Environment:
  ALUCARD_CACHE_DIR            Where GitHub repos, and the shared Playwright
                               browser cache, are kept between runs.
                               Default: ~/.cache/alucard  (XDG_CACHE_HOME honoured)
  ALUCARD_TASKS_FILE           Default tasks file for the local task source
                               (equivalent to passing --tasks).
  ALUCARD_CLAUDE_MODEL         Claude model for all agent roles. Default: sonnet
  ALUCARD_CLAUDE_FALLBACK_MODEL
                               Claude fallback model. Default: haiku
  ALUCARD_EFFORT               Claude --effort level for all agent roles.
                               Default: unset (flag omitted).
  ALUCARD_CODEX_MODEL          Codex model for all agent roles. Default: gpt-5.6-terra
  ALUCARD_<ROLE>_CLAUDE_MODEL, ALUCARD_<ROLE>_CLAUDE_FALLBACK_MODEL,
  ALUCARD_<ROLE>_EFFORT, ALUCARD_<ROLE>_CODEX_MODEL
                               Per-role overrides (ROLE is WORKER, CI_FIX,
                               REVIEWER, or FEEDBACK), each falling back to
                               the corresponding global var above, then its
                               default.
  ALUCARD_WORKER_MAX_TURNS     Worker --max-turns (Claude only). Default: 180
  ALUCARD_WORKER_MAX_BUDGET    Worker --max-budget-usd (Claude only). Default: 10
  ALUCARD_CI_FIX_MAX_TURNS     CI-fix --max-turns (Claude only). Default: 30
  ALUCARD_CI_FIX_MAX_BUDGET    CI-fix --max-budget-usd (Claude only). Default: 2
  ALUCARD_REVIEWER_MAX_TURNS   Reviewer --max-turns (Claude only). Default: 45
  ALUCARD_REVIEWER_MAX_BUDGET  Reviewer --max-budget-usd (Claude only). Default: 2
  ALUCARD_FEEDBACK_MAX_TURNS   Feedback --max-turns (Claude only). Default: 50
  ALUCARD_FEEDBACK_MAX_BUDGET  Feedback --max-budget-usd (Claude only). Default: 2
  ALUCARD_WRAPUP_MAX_TURNS     Wrap-up --max-turns (Claude only): the short agent
                               that commits a stopped worker's leftovers and
                               writes the recovery PR's handoff. 0 disables it.
                               Runs with the WORKER role's provider and model.
                               Default: 12
  ALUCARD_WRAPUP_MAX_BUDGET    Wrap-up --max-budget-usd (Claude only). Default: 1
  ALUCARD_TRANSPORT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
                               Extra attempts after a transport-classified worker
                               failure, same ticket, fresh worktree each time.
                               Default: 2 (3 total attempts).

Examples:
  alucard run owner/repo --iterations 1
  alucard run owner/repo --issue 90
  alucard run /path/to/target-repo --iterations 1 --timeout-minutes 10
  ALUCARD_TARGET_REPO=/path/to/target-repo alucard run -n 20 -t 30
  cd /path/to/target-repo && alucard queue
  alucard continue 174 -C /path/to/target-repo
  alucard merge 174 owner/repo --check-command 'just ci'
